configuration.title: Code Explain
configuration.apiBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL (for example, https://api.openai.com/v1 or your gateway /v1).
configuration.apiKey.description: AI API Key (prefer SecretStorage via the Set AI API Key command).
configuration.cursorApiKey.description: Deprecated: use codeExplain.apiKey or Set AI API Key. Kept for migration from Cursor-only config.
configuration.model.description: Model ID accepted by your API provider (for example, gpt-4o-mini or deepseek-chat).
configuration.outputLanguage.description: Language for AI-generated explanation and grading text (settings: Code Explain → Output Language). Extension UI still follows the VS Code display language.
configuration.outputLanguage.zhCN: Chinese (zh-CN) — AI explanations and feedback in Chinese
configuration.outputLanguage.enUS: English (en-US) — AI explanations and feedback in English
configuration.storageRoot.description: Custom absolute path for learning progress and question bank files. Empty uses extension global storage.
